boundary_optimum.criterion: zero-delta margin exceeds all positive-delta rows by >=0.1 and spans >=2 (n_trans,cs2_q) slices

branch_topology.method: central-pressure ordered local dM/dlog(P_c) slope with first local mass peak termination
branch_topology.unresolved_policy: short/non-supported runs are excluded from row interpretation

domain.zero_width_transition_note: A delta_eps=0 limiting transition has a zero-energy step; its zero-width numerical row is excluded from dP/dε rather than called superluminal.

provenance.selection_note: J0740/GW170817/NICER constraints are selection inputs; all downstream comparisons are conditional/in-sample and carry no independent evidence weight.

density_jump_treatment.representation_rule: pressure-table resampling copies transition metadata and reconstructs the low-phase branch; no finite-width plateau is used to approximate a positive density jump.

source.citation: Postnikov, Prakash & Lattimer (2010), Phys. Rev. D 82, 024016, arXiv:1004.5098
source.geometric_conversion: Delta_epsilon_geo = k_conv * Delta_epsilon[MeV/fm^3], m_t_geo = M_solar * M_sun_km
source.jump_sign: positive Delta_epsilon lowers y across the interface

density_jump_treatment.zero_jump_semantics: delta_eps=0 rows use the same matching hook with a zero update; the canonical EOS constructor remains unchanged and retains its historical zero-jump runtime path.
